name: What maintenance is required for built-in shelving?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for built-in shelving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance for built-in shelving is generally minimal, primarily involving regular dusting and occasional cleaning with a mild, non-abrasive cleaner suitable for the specific material and finish. Avoid harsh chemicals or excessive moisture, especially on wood. For painted surfaces, touch-up kits can address minor scuffs. Periodically inspect the shelving for any loose fasteners, although professional installation typically ensures long-term stability. Proper care helps preserve the beauty and longevity of your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance is minimal, including regular dusting and cleaning with a mild cleaner. Avoid harsh chemicals and periodically inspect for loose fasteners to ensure longevity.
